name: Residual-based Difference Visualization
definition: A visualization mode to reveal structural differences between a reference volume (rendered with $T_r$) and an optimized volume (rendered with $T_o$) by rendering the residual field between them.
summary: Residual-based Difference Visualization reveals structural discrepancies between rendered volumes by computing the residual of transfer-function-applied fields, distinguishing it from standard methods that compare raw scalar values.
